summary: UI toggle increment/decrement handler: reads the current toggle value through the pointer stored at this[200] (offset 0x320), adjusts it by +1 when a2 == 1 or -1 otherwise, clamps the result to the range [0,1], writes the clamped value back through the same pointer, then calls EditBufferStringUpdate with a 32-byte stack buffer and returns its result.

operations.description: Load the toggle value pointer v2 from this[200] (offset 0x320, constructor-initialized to 0).
Read the current toggle value v3 = *v2.
Adjust the value by direction: v4 = v3 + 1 when a2 == 1 (increment), otherwise v4 = v3 - 1 (decrement).
Clamp v4 to [0,1]: force 0 when negative, force 1 when greater than 1.
Call EditBufferStringUpdate(v6) with a 32-byte stack buffer and return its result.
